title: The Beatles: Ringo
overview: One of four biopics, focusing on individual members of The Beatles, this one telling the story of the group from the perspective of Ringo Starr.

title: The Beatles: Paul
overview: One of four biopics, focusing on individual members of The Beatles, this one telling the story of the group from the perspective of Paul McCartney.

title: The Beatles: George
overview: One of four biopics, focusing on individual members of The Beatles, this one telling the story of the group from the perspective of George Harrison.

title: The Beatles: John
overview: One of four biopics, focusing on individual members of The Beatles, this one telling the story of the group from the perspective of John Lennon.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Wichita Monrovians vs. Klan Lodge #6
overview: The history of an infamous baseball game between the barnstorming Wichita Monrovians and the KKK is re-examined by historians, activists, and players.

title: Promises
overview: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

title: High in the Clouds
overview: After he accidentally sparked a revolution against Gretsch, the bossy diva-owl who has banned all music from his town, a teenage squirrel named Wirral embarks on an extraordinary journey to set music free.

title: Buried Secrets
overview: \When a girl goes missing on a treasure hunt, her sister and a group of friends assemble to locate her and find the buried treasure. But what they end up discovering is a centuries old Demon with sinister plans of his own.

title: Bollywoof
overview: A very British springer spaniel is lost in India, trying to find his human family. Basil the spaniel must team up with a streetwise Bollywood-obsessed street dog to survive.

title: Classified
overview: "I can’t put words to you, I can’t put labels to you; but what I can put are a whole ton of emotions and feelings to you, and even then I can’t put words to those."

title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
original_title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

title: Enzo: The Mafias Boxer
overview: Enzo Provino (Played by Alex Javo) is an up-and-coming boxer who is instructed by the local mafia boss Bruno Rossi (Eric Roberts) and his consigliere Giorgio Cantini (Frank Stallone) to throw a very crucial boxing match. He is rewarded for his loyalty and is given an offer, he cannot refuse. A chance to become a made member of the family with a shot at the title. As he grows and climbs the ladder of the ranks, Enzo begins to unfold secrets linking his family to the original mafia from Sicily.

title: Monster Mati Lampu
overview: A man is unable to sleep during a total power outage in his city; while trying to drift off, he hears something and decides to record it as evidence.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: Quarter
overview: Kelly, a young woman living with Type 1 diabetes, is about to turn 25, as she deals with the ups and downs of her blood sugar levels and the ups and downs of her personal life.

title: Whiddy
overview: A small rural community in Ireland welcomes in a major, global oil company with open arms but just 10 years and numerous oil spills later, that dream turns into an unimaginable nightmare. 50 lives lost in a tragedy that silenced and divided the community and still haunts it to this day.

title: 10 Days Later
overview: Told by the players, first responders, and fans who were there, 10 Days Later revisits the night Mike Piazza's eighth-inning home run turned the first ballgame after 9/11 into a moment of collective healing.

title: David Walliams: Power and Silence
overview: A three-year joint investigation by ITV News and the Guardian reveals allegations dating back to 2003 that David Walliams preyed on teenage girls and young women for sexual purposes.

title: Mums v Big Pharma
overview: Mums v Big Pharma is a powerful BBC Two documentary that chronicles the long, dogged campaign by mothers—led by Janet Williams and Emma Murphy—to expose the devastating health scandal surrounding the anti-seizure medication sodium valproate (commonly known as Epilim).

title: Red Ink
overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

title: Diana in the Leaves
overview: Roger and Diana, a pair of writers soon to be wed, have just moved into the granny flat that stands beside Diana’s childhood home. They’ve escaped the hustle of their previous city life for a quieter, rural one. Yet, the ideas brewing in Roger’s mind are loud, cutting through the peace of the bush and turning it into something that, in Diana’s eyes, it is not. Attempting to understand the bush and its secrets, Roger becomes inspired by the concept of hunting. What does it feel like to hunt? What does it feel like to be hunted? Armed with only his imagination and a pen, he goes as ‘method’ with it as he can. But undictated by reality, his ‘hunting’ quickly spirals into a delusional power trip, bringing new revelations not only about the state of his writing, but the state of his relationship with Diana.

title: Pūtaringa
overview: Follow Pete as he explores the struggles of an overwhelming new environment and finds comfort in the small things that remind him of home.

title: Marriage Test
overview: In a mosque waiting room in 1980s South Wales, a young Welsh woman and her Iranian fiancé prepare for an Islamic conversion ceremony that will test the strength of their love and their resolve.

title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

title: The Search for Dinner
overview: After a chaotic neighbour eats everything in the house, a starving Matthew sets off in a hunger-fuelled trance that leads him into one bizarre food disaster after another. His brother Benji, their gang-affiliated cousin Peter and the very neighbour who caused it all must find him before it’s too late.

title: the FUDGE BUNCH
overview: Daytime television at its finest: two brothers, one girl, and a baby that ain’t nobody’s. Follow host Garry Spooger as he gets to the bottom of a family feud to find out 'who is the father'?

title: All The Things We Haven't Done
original_title: All The Things We Haven't Done
overview: A lonely young man goes through an ordinary day while listening to a voice message, slowly rediscovering the small moments and connections that make life feel a little less empty.

title: The Holiday Spark
overview: Firefight Dean enlists illustrator Laura to help plan a holiday party for his firehouse. As they plan the epic party, both begin to question their views on romance and the possibility of love at first spark.

title: The Nutcracker Wish
overview: After Clara, a small town dance teacher, is gifted a 'magical' Nutcracker, the real-life version shows up at her front door. But what seemed a holiday serendipity may instead destroy her family legacy.

title: A Royal Christmas Switch
overview: When Prince Alexander of Belvaria crosses paths with Ethan, a small-town man who looks like his twin, they decide to swap places for the Christmas season so Alexander can finally experience a normal holiday.

title: I promise I won't bore you.
original_title: I promise I won't bore you.
overview: Failing birthday clown and cam-star Mary wades through the messy world of T4T dating after being voted out from her polycule.

title: FYRE 2: The Billy McFarland Story
overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary following Billy McFarland's attempt to revive the notorious FYRE Festival. From preparations, negotiations and setbacks surrounding FYRE 2 to his subsequent ventures in the Caribbean, the film explores the complicated pursuit of a comeback landing him on the small island of Utila in Honduras.

title: His Daughter
overview: Based on the life of Susan Atkins, who was forced to step into the role of a parent for her younger brother while her own home was broken by her parents' alcoholism and the death of her mother, this is how the constant struggle and the lack of a support system led her to trade one form of survival for a much darker, more destructive life that became her permanent reality.

title: None of Us?
overview: Ren, the traditional picture of new grad success, finds herself slowly dissolving into an online existence. In a space where nothing means anything, how do you still feel like a winner? When Ren unexpectedly meets someone in real life who is connected to her corner of the internet, she is forced to confront what she has become and who she wants to be.

title: Alone
overview: A lonely young man is spending a night by himself in his apartment and begins to suspect he might not actually be alone.

title: One-Off
overview: When a death row convicted taxi driver picks his final meal, a twisted cook is determined to make it his most memorable.

title: Teen Spirits
overview: In a deserted high school, a group of teenagers gathers for a mysterious choral ritual.

title: Plan B
overview: When a hippie dealer and his pregnant, latina girlfriend find themselves transporting more than just mushrooms in the back of their car, they will either grow together or apart as new parents.

title: Masih Ada Gak?
overview: Eva, who sells secondhand clothing via TikTok Live, found that what began as an ordinary evening took an unexpected turn with the arrival of a ‘mysterious’ buyer.

title: Malina
overview: After her young son disappears, Ana discovers her husband’s affair with her closest friend. Torn between grief and betrayal, she struggles to know whom to trust as a malevolent presence threatens to destroy her world.

title: Decluterring
overview: A college freshman becomes haunted by his childhood Muppets.

title: Scream: Short Film
overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

title: In the Shadows
overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

title: On The Line
overview: When a teenage boy (Shylo Molina) hangs up on a suicide prevention counselor, (Rosa Salazar) she risks everything to find him. Stealing her boss's car, she sets off on an extraordinary journey that becomes a funny, bittersweet road trip between two strangers who were, only hours earlier, just voices on the line.  Along the way, it becomes clear which one them needs saving.

title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
original_title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
overview: A dark, camp-infused comedy about Mel, a non-binary person coming to terms with their identity. Much to their dismay, Evy ropes them into a Samhain retreat with their friends Remy, Tyler, and Sage. All Hades breaks loose when a demon from Mel's past returns to haunt them all after a seance goes awry. Mel is confronted by the demon they accidentally summoned in childhood - a manifestation of fear, shame, and unresolved identity. While their friends navigate their own Queer expressions through drag makeup, chaotic flirtations, and substance-fueled denial, Mel’s journey unfolds more subtly.

title: The Whistling Game
overview: A woman searching for her missing brother travels into the wilderness of Dartmoor, England, documenting her investigation as she follows the trail he left behind. As her search deepens, she encounters an ancient mystery, while her camera captures increasingly inexplicable events.

title: GINA
overview: After killing a man under the orders of a mysterious criminal organisation, Gina waits alone in a bloodstained apartment for a cleaner who never arrives. As the hours drag on, paranoia, guilt, and the threat of betrayal begin to close in around her. Trapped between the consequences of her actions and the people who orchestrated them, Gina must confront the terrifying reality that she was never meant to escape. A tense and darkly ironic crime thriller about manipulation, accountability, and survival.

title: Dreamboat
overview: When an underground musician’s unconventional romance with her beloved pillow is violently cut short by her mother, she spirals into a delirious odyssey through Mumbai, where her friendships, desires, and grip on reality are tested by an enigmatic homeless poet. As she searches for love and connection in an increasingly alienating city, the abandoned pillow begins to develop a will of its own.

title: A River Colored Red
overview: In a mining-scarred Adivasi village under the shadow of the state–Naxal conflict, a 12-year-old boy’s encounter with a Tiger Spirit in the form of his long-dead uncle leads him to his family’s missing buffalo while uncovering buried memories of loss and violence. A Mundari language film.

title: Remote
overview: When a housebound computer programmer witnesses a murder on a random webcam feed, she must race to unmask the killer before she becomes his next victim.

title: Her Daughters’ Mother
overview: After getting married at the age of 16, Ejiro is thrown into a world she is unprepared for, seeking freedom and agency in hopeless places.

title: The Lost Ones
overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

title: In the Ever
overview: Blending intimate voice-over with the fractured memories of a 1970s folksinger, IN THE EVER follows Sam Ellis, a mechanic, whose songs written for his dead mother become a surprise hit. Unable to cope with fame, Sam retreats to a desert ranch, where an unexpected love affair forces him to confront his pain in order to move forward.  The film is a love letter infused in music. With 70s needle drops, an original score by Sonny Luca, and original music by lead actor and co-writer/director C.M. Sutton, watching IN THE EVER feels like listening to a complete album.

title: Heathens
overview: A groundbreaking 2024 University of Chicago study, presented at the Society for the Scientific Study of Religion, has uncovered something stunning: more than 50 million American Christians now conceal private doubts about their faith—a quiet crisis of doubt hidden behind Sunday smiles. This nationally representative research—the first of its kind—reveals the emotional and social toll of concealment: anxiety, shame, family rupture, and the quiet unraveling of identity in communities where belief defines belonging.

title: Tabby Daly
overview: As the potato blight tears through a rural community, a charitable woman helps young boys emigrate in search of a better life. But as quiet doubts begin to surface, questions emerge about her true intentions.

title: This Happens at Every Party...
overview: A man stands paralyzed while a battle between his friends and his bladder controls his night, fearful of pissing either of them off.

title: THIS TOWN AIN'T BIG ENOUGH FOR THE BOTH OF US
original_title: THIS TOWN AIN'T BIG ENOUGH FOR THE BOTH OF US
overview: Aubrey meets Indiana, a wannabe cowboy. When they bond over their unhappy marriages, a romance blooms between the two. But when their husbands find out, could it be the end for both of them?

title: GunBlade & Me
overview: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

title: Intoxication
overview: During a remote houseboat bachelor party on Shasta Lake, a groom and his best man tangle with a shadowy New Age cult, only to inadvertently summon an ancient entity into their beer keg, turning their getaway into a floating nightmare.

title: VIEWFINDER
overview: Evil is in the eye of the beholder.

title: Dating Sucks
overview: A vampiress navigates the turmoils of modern dating.

title: Fever Dreams
overview: Nick pieces together a mystery from his childhood: who, or what, killed his mother.

title: Boy Mom
overview: A nervous woman meets her adult boyfriend's overbearing mother.

title: Last Night at the Alamo
overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

title: The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
original_title: The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
overview: This drug awareness short follows Billy, a teenager who smokes weed for the first time and turns his night into a hellish nightmare.

title: Outsiders
overview: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

title: Vanishing Point
overview: Three urban explorers enter an abandoned office building in search of forgotten spaces, but as the layout shifts and reality frays, they find themselves trapped in a 'liminal' maze that quietly erases their sense of time, place and each other.

title: A Girl Called Alice
overview: In the middle of London's mobile phone theft epidemic; a young woman with the reputation of one of the most gifted phone thieves is challenged by a notorious street gang leader to see just how good she really is, but is it a wise choice?

title: Jackrabbit
overview: Investigative reporter George moves to New York, but needs a roommate. Knowing no one else in the city except her childhood best friend Trish, George agrees to move in with Trish’s city bestie, Avery, an aspiring actress and full-time mess. Due to a clash of personality and a series of mishaps, the two women quickly end up at each other’s throats – and competing for Trish’s friendship. Until one day when Trish mysteriously vanishes. The women are then reluctantly forced to team up to track down their friend, only to discover that Trish’s disappearance is just the first of many secrets.

title: Damilola Taylor: The Untold Story
overview: Ten-year-old Damilola Taylor was fatally stabbed in 2000 in a stairwell in Peckham, South East London, just metres from his home. 'Star Wars' star John Boyega, who also grew up in Peckham, speaks for the first time about being one of the last people to see him alive, sharing the fear and uncertainty that followed in the aftermath of Taylor's death. Boyega is joined by close friends and family members of Taylor, who reveal the events that led to his death and talk for the first time about the impact his tragic murder has had in shaping their lives.

title: Travel Reminiscence
overview: At a London community centre, facilitators and volunteers run a travel-themed session for people living with dementia and their families, friends and carers.  Together, the group embarks on a playful journey: discussing past trips, revisiting these through theatre, and writing postcards to loved ones.

title: Adore Him
overview: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

title: Gansey
overview: As a woman washes and puts a Guernsey jumper out to dry, the symbolism of the jumper and the design of its stitches creates a sense of identity for the island.

title: A Thrift Story
overview: It’s Amy’s last day at the no-name thrift store where she works, but she’s got one last difficult customer to deal with.

title: Take His Life
overview: Beneath the glitter of London's finance world, a destitute man forces his way back from the streets into power. Over the course of a week, his hunger for success hardens into obsession, exposing a ruthless truth: in a system built on glass, survival demands taking another's life.

title: Nickels
overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Dropping Off
overview: An aspiring musician gigging as a rideshare driver struggles to navigate the bizarre request of a mourning passenger.

title: Best of the Best
overview: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

title: Tiny Fugitives
overview: A reckless group of twelve year olds set out on a mission to spend the rest of their lives at sleepaway camp. They'll just have to get past Bob - the camp's deranged, relentless, 50-year-old lifer counselor.

title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: Dying for Love
overview: In 1991 Miami, a young woman secretly dying of HIV finally finds the man of her dreams, and risks the only thing scarier than her diagnosis—telling the fatal truth to the man she loves.

title: Vaulder
overview: Something stalks a group at night in the suburbs.

title: & Ever
overview: @rgray828 and @Ever_06 meet for the first time.

title: Alpha Gang
overview: The Alpha Gang are alien invaders sent on a mission to conquer Earth. Disguised in human form, armed and dangerous, and clad in 1950’s leather biker get-up, they show no mercy… until they catch the most toxic, contagious human disease of all: emotion.

title: Resident Dead
overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

title: Ephemera
overview: In a strange future, a national security agent with pyrotechnic abilities is horribly burned in battle and develops a fear of fire. She returns to action but cannot shake her fear. She undergoes experimental procedures to gain new powers and sets out to get revenge on those who destroyed her life. This film is reminiscent of such science fiction classics as Blade Runner and Ready Player One.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: The Sorrows of Young Charlotte
overview: After a devastating break-up, Charlie sleeps with her friend Werther on a whim. But when he confesses his true feelings for her, an unnerving and darkly explosive argument erupts.

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: Rocket Friendz
overview: In a world of mediocrity, Theo is a Rocket Friendz Battle Trainer with ONE goal: for he and his Rocket Friend Snout to BE THE BEST! He has been trying for 27 years!
